{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many entries have commas
num_with_commas = has_commas.sum()
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {num_with_commas}")

# Confirm if any of these are actually non-zero
comma_rows = data[has_commas]
print("Comma-containing revenue values:", comma_rows['revenue'].unique())"}
